verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of n8n's wait/pause mechanism, execution state persistence across worker or platform restarts, or queue-mode durability for long-running workflows. Error-workflow handling (n8n-docs-5) and execution history search (n8n-docs-9, n8n-comm-8) address failure notification and debugging, not surviving restarts during multi-day waits, so this applicable reliability axis is unevidenced.
